nodes.label: ggplot
nodes.desc: Central object; __init__ wires data, mapping, Layers(), Scales(), facet_null(), coord_cartesian(), theme_get() and Layout().

nodes.label: guides
nodes.desc: Collects legends and axis titles, trains them, and draw() returns an OffsetBox tree placed in the figure side space.

nodes.label: build()
nodes.desc: deepcopy(self), then the ordered sequence: aesthetics, scale transforms, position training, statistics, position adjustments, defaults, finish_data.

nodes.label: PlotBuild
nodes.desc: Frozen dataclass snapshot (layers, scales, layout, facet, labels) returned by build(); building never mutates the user's plot.

nodes.label: draw()
nodes.desc: Render entry: _setup, _build, then coordinates/guides/theme _setup, then ordered drawing ending in theme.apply().

nodes.label: layer
nodes.desc: One data+mapping+stat+geom bundle; resolves geom/stat/position strings via _resolve_geom/_resolve_stat/_resolve_position.

nodes.label: Layers
nodes.desc: list[layer] subclass; its setup/compute_*/train/map methods are exactly the steps ggplot.build() calls in order.

nodes.label: compute_aesthetics()
nodes.desc: Evaluates each aes expression in the captured Environment and renames columns to the generalized aesthetic names.

nodes.label: add_group()
nodes.desc: Derives the group aesthetic via ninteraction over discrete columns; label, geometry, where and subgroup are excluded.

nodes.label: _make_layer_data()
nodes.desc: Any object exposing to_pandas() (e.g. a polars DataFrame) is converted; user data is copied, never mutated.

nodes.label: position
nodes.desc: Adjustment base with collide() and collide2() strategies; subclasses stack, dodge, jitter, nudge, fill.

nodes.label: stat
nodes.desc: ABC registered through the Register metaclass; declares REQUIRED_AES and defaults so layers can fill missing aesthetics.

nodes.label: compute_layer()
nodes.desc: Validates required aesthetics, drops missing rows, then groupby_apply(data, 'PANEL', fn) fans work out per panel.

nodes.label: compute_panel()
nodes.desc: Receives one panel's data plus its position scales and delegates to compute_group() per group.

nodes.label: compute_group()
nodes.desc: The hook most statistics override; only sees one group's dataframe.

nodes.label: stat_bin
nodes.desc: Histogram binning with fuzzy breaks handling for edges of the range.

nodes.label: stat_smooth
nodes.desc: Fits smoothers per group (lm, glm, loess, lowess via statsmodels) and builds confidence-interval ribbons.

nodes.label: _swarm.py
nodes.desc: Beeswarm layout: van_der_corput sequences, density estimation and smiley/frowney/spread offsets keep points non-overlapping.

nodes.label: geom
nodes.desc: ABC with Register metaclass; handle_na, use_defaults and the draw_layer/draw_panel/draw_group fan-out live here.

nodes.label: draw_layer()
nodes.desc: Splits layer data by PANEL and hands each panel to draw_panel().

nodes.label: draw_group()
nodes.desc: Where a geom actually builds matplotlib artists for one group; draw_legend() paints the matching key.

nodes.label: geom_point
nodes.desc: Scatter plots via ax.scatter with mapping of size/colour/shape scales.

nodes.label: geom_path
nodes.desc: Largest geom (18.7 KB): ordered paths, multi-line grouping, and an inner arrow class for line-ending decorations.

nodes.label: facet
nodes.desc: Base facet: compute_layout(), train_position_scales(), finish_data(), make_strips(), _make_gridspec().

nodes.label: facet_wrap
nodes.desc: Wraps a 1-d ribbon of panels; subclasses facet.

nodes.label: facet_grid
nodes.desc: 2-d row/column grid including marginal panels; subclasses facet.

nodes.label: Layout
nodes.desc: The PANEL dataframe: setup(), train_position(), map_position(), reset_position_scales(), setup_panel_params().

nodes.label: scale
nodes.desc: Dataclass per aesthetic: transform/inverse, train/map, default_expansion() padding and final_limits().

nodes.label: Scales
nodes.desc: list[scale] with find/get_scales, non_position_scales(), train_df/map_df and add_missing(('x','y')).

nodes.label: coord
nodes.desc: Base coordinate system; transform(), munch() resample data onto panels, setup_panel_params() fixes ranges.

nodes.label: p9Figure
nodes.desc: Figure subclass with an owner back-reference that stamps plotnine-created artists.

nodes.label: PlotnineLayoutEngine
nodes.desc: Registered as the figure's LayoutEngine; execute() positions panels, strips, titles, legends and insets.

nodes.label: LayoutTree
nodes.desc: Tree of plot/composition layout items; align() and resize() propagate widths/heights from leaves upward.

nodes.label: theme
nodes.desc: Themeables resolve into rcParams and artist targets; apply() runs after drawing so defaults never clobber plotnine's values.
